title: Continue or Fold? "White Room" - a AI agent that lives inside a white room
author: jin_sprited
selftext:
I'm trying to see if I can bring an AI character to life inside a website. Right now I am just using AI-generated character, but I would like to make it more rich in the future using hand drawn characters.

  
It is similar in concept with Neurosama. I am not 100% sure if going this route would be worth my time. If I can I want to work on all the memory system and a story line for the character and make it truly feel like a living being that people connect with.

It is one of 3 project I'm working on and I need to choose between those. Do you think it is worthwhile to pursue this direction?
